branch_specific_reverse_trace.estimand: Locked output effect attributable to the weakest link of each branch-specific b30-to-b29-to-b28-to-sequence reverse chain.
branch_specific_reverse_trace.decision_rule: Require at least two independent candidate methods, a positive held-out output intervention, and a leakage-penalized bottleneck score above the declared margin; otherwise report partial, bounded-null, or unidentified tracing.
branch_specific_reverse_trace.control_plan: Run all controls on the identical locked units and endpoint as each branch-specific reverse direction.

common_reverse_trace.estimand: Locked output effect attributable to the weakest link of the common b30-to-b29-to-b28-to-sequence reverse chain.
common_reverse_trace.decision_rule: Require at least two independent candidate methods, a positive held-out output intervention, and a leakage-penalized bottleneck score above the declared margin; otherwise report partial, bounded-null, or unidentified tracing.
common_reverse_trace.control_plan: Run all controls on the identical locked units and endpoint as the common reverse direction.

cross_chromosome_generalization.estimand: Preservation of the frozen mechanism across untouched chromosome, task family, model size, checkpoint, context, and training time.
cross_chromosome_generalization.decision_rule: Require dependency-cluster confidence bounds for every preregistered domain, internally replayed locked checkpoint predictions, and sustained multi-seed training crossings; do not average away a failed domain.
cross_chromosome_generalization.control_plan: Use the exact same unit panel for every mechanism-domain cell and fit alignment/predictor only on disjoint discovery/development anchors.

exp1_extension.estimand: Out-of-family improvement in explaining EXP1 cases with the fixed EXP2 stage ontology plus the frozen EXP3 factorization fingerprint.
exp1_extension.decision_rule: Evaluate predeclared stage labels and outcomes on held-out task families; require the full fingerprint to beat task-only and shuffled-fingerprint baselines without selecting on EXP1 outcomes.
exp1_extension.control_plan: Use identical family folds, labels, units, and budgets for all feature sets and baselines.

feature_model_on_branch_delta.estimand: Held-out branch-specific causal-delta prediction and suffix rescue attributable to a sparse feature vocabulary.
feature_model_on_branch_delta.decision_rule: Choose complexity by the development one-standard-error rule and require locked delta prediction, feature ablation, decoded rescue, specificity controls, and cross-chromosome stability; reconstruction alone never passes.
feature_model_on_branch_delta.control_plan: Fit on train, select complexity on development, freeze the feature artifact, and intervene once on the ordered locked unit panel.

feature_model_on_causal_delta.estimand: Held-out common causal-delta prediction and suffix rescue attributable to a sparse feature vocabulary.
feature_model_on_causal_delta.decision_rule: Choose complexity by the development one-standard-error rule and require locked delta prediction, feature ablation, decoded rescue, specificity controls, and cross-chromosome stability; reconstruction alone never passes.
feature_model_on_causal_delta.control_plan: Fit on train, select complexity on development, freeze the feature artifact, and intervene once on the ordered locked unit panel.

feature_target_refinement.estimand: Identifiability of a bounded intervention delta suitable for optional feature modeling.
feature_target_refinement.decision_rule: Open a feature model only after a target-free held-out prediction recreates the locked delta and produces suffix rescue above controls; otherwise retain the raw-geometry conclusion and keep feature interpretation closed.
feature_target_refinement.control_plan: Refine only on development and evaluate the frozen target exactly once on locked units.

learned_transport.estimand: Recovery of the locked late-stack causal delta and output endpoint by a model fitted only to randomized train/development intervention deltas.
learned_transport.decision_rule: Require internally regenerated locked prediction, positive delta geometry, real suffix rescue, and superiority over every mandatory matched control; a cached actual delta or caller-supplied hash cannot pass.
learned_transport.control_plan: Generate every endpoint in the same suffix runner with per-unit dose matching, ordered units, and a sealed runtime receipt.

mechanism_application.estimand: Incremental locked benefit of stage-matched diagnosis, repair, carrier calibration, compression, and sequence steering over matched alternatives.
mechanism_application.decision_rule: Seal diagnosis or candidate selection before locked outcomes and require stage-matched benefit plus wrong-stage/random/off-target controls; each application is reported separately if another is unsupported.
mechanism_application.control_plan: Use one sealed selected action and an independent locked validation panel for each application.

motif_variant_replay.estimand: Locked motif or variant effect transported in the immediate ordered g28-to-b29-to-m30 serial circuit and selectively rescued at the output.
motif_variant_replay.decision_rule: Require candidate-method consensus, insertion/deletion or held-out edit, all positive/equivalence contrasts, at least three specificity families, and a separately sealed ordered serial-path verdict.
motif_variant_replay.control_plan: Run motif/variant, matched controls, immediate block/rescue links, and reverse-order failures on the same locked families and endpoint.

reverse_trace_identifiability.estimand: Identifiability of a stable output-causal direction and its weakest reverse-chain link before motif replay.
reverse_trace_identifiability.decision_rule: Refine rank/window only on development, require two-method agreement and a positive held-out intervention, and report an explicit unidentified or bounded-null target if consensus remains absent.
reverse_trace_identifiability.control_plan: No locked retuning; each refinement candidate is selected on development and evaluated on the identical locked panel.

task_heterogeneity.estimand: Out-of-family prediction of benchmark performance and failure stage from the frozen ten-axis mechanism fingerprint.
task_heterogeneity.decision_rule: Freeze fingerprint construction before labels and require leave-family-out improvement over task-only, scale-only, and shuffled-fingerprint baselines at identical label budgets.
task_heterogeneity.control_plan: Use identical task-family folds, dependency groups, labels, and budgets for all models.
